name: 阿斯克
src: 月银纪史诗/第一歌_灰桥初火.md:299
who: Ask, a human hunter of the far north, twenty years old: tall, about 184 cm, a narrow-waisted, broad-shouldered archer's build with the long drawing-back of ten years of the bow. Long dark-red hair down to the middle of his back, tied loosely at the nape with a leather thong, a few strands falling over the corners of his eyes; the red is deep and dull. Cold ice-blue eyes that look at people for a long time, like stones under river ice. A thin old scar across the bridge of the nose from a lynx. A lean face with a clean jaw. Fair skin, the fingers callused by bowstrings. He stands motionless like a bow that has been unstrung and set down. Quiet and watchful. The thin pale old scar across the bridge of his nose must be clearly visible in every panel and in every expression face: a distinct narrow pale diagonal line crossing the nose bridge between the eyes, not hidden by hair.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean young man's face of about twenty, narrow, sharply slanted ice-blue eyes with a long thin dark-red upper lash line, straight dark-red eyebrows, a thin pale scar across the bridge of the nose, a clean jaw, a closed mouth held level; skin shadows a cool pale pink.
build: 184 cm, lean and tall: broad shoulders and a long strong back from years of drawing a bow, a narrow waist, long arms, hard callused fingers.
palette: dark red hair, ice blue, white wolf fur and snow, smoked deerskin brown, bone and old iron grey
casual: His hunting clothes: a white wolf pelt worn over the shoulders with the wolf's head pulled up as a hood, over a smoked deerskin short coat and an undyed wool shirt, leg wraps bound up to below the knee, feet wrapped in hide strips; a tall yew longbow, half a head taller than he is, carried across the back, a quiver of birch arrows fletched with crow feathers, the heads half bone and half old scavenged iron, at his right hip. He stands still, the face calm and watchful.
private: Resting by a fire: the wolf pelt off and folded over one arm, a smoked deerskin short coat over a long-sleeved undyed wool shirt, leg wraps and hide-wrapped boots, the dark-red hair loose over one shoulder, the bow leaning unstrung against his side. He turns a bone arrowhead over in his fingers; a quiet, level look.
battle: Ready to shoot from the snow: the white wolf pelt pulled up with the wolf's head as a hood, the deerskin short coat belted tight, leather bracers on both forearms, leg wraps. He holds the tall yew longbow drawn halfway in both hands, an arrow with a bone-and-iron head on the string; the quiver rides at his right hip; the ice-blue eyes narrow on a far mark, the mouth shut.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: standing braced side-on, the feet planted wide, the tall yew longbow drawn in both hands and an arrow nocked, the ice-blue eyes fixed on a far target, the mouth closed, the white wolf hood up.
formal: At the fire-handing at first snow: the cleanest smoked deerskin coat brushed and belted with a rawhide thong, a fresh undyed wool shirt under it, the white wolf pelt laid evenly over both shoulders with the head resting on his chest. Around his neck on a cord hangs the soot-blackened little clay fire-pot, a rime of white frost on its mouth and a live ember glowing inside. He holds the unstrung yew longbow upright beside him like a staff; a stern, steady look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the ice-blue eyes looking straight at the viewer, cold and patient, the mouth closed. The white wolf hood frames the dark-red hair; cold blue snow light from the left, a faint orange firelight on the other cheek. Foreground blur: drifting snow and the soft shape of a bow limb.

name: 阿尔姆
src: 月银纪史诗/第一歌_灰桥初火.md:345
who: Alm, a human hunter of the far north, eighteen years old, the younger of two brothers: about 178 cm, sturdy, with strong shoulders and thick arms built from throwing spears since boyhood, the forearms dotted with old small burn scars. A messy mop of bright red hair that sticks up, brighter than his brother's, two thin braids by the ears with a wolf tooth tied to the end of each. Spring-green eyes that squint into slits when he laughs, showing a prominent canine tooth. Cheeks and nose burnt red by summer wildfire, the nose always peeling. Fair skin otherwise. A loud, cheerful, hot-blooded air; always feels warm and always hungry.
face: FACE, as in the references: a cheerful young man's face of about eighteen, round-ish, gently slanted spring-green eyes that crinkle shut when he grins, a thin tapering upper lash line, bushy bright red eyebrows, cheeks and nose flushed red with a peeling nose, a wide grin that shows a single pointed canine tooth, a strong chin; skin shadows a warm pink-orange.
build: 178 cm, sturdy: broad shoulders, thick forearms with small old burn scars, a strong trunk and solid legs.
palette: bright red hair, spring green, bear-fur brown, bone white, flushed red cheeks
casual: His everyday clothes: a bear-fur sleeveless vest worn open even in winter over a short undyed wool shirt with the sleeves pushed to the elbow, forearms bare and reddened by the cold; wool trousers, leg wraps and hide boots; a bundle of seven fire-hardened wooden spears with bone tips tied together and slung across his back; a leather pouch of dried meat at his belt. He grins, flushed and cheerful.
private: Off duty: the bear vest off, a long-sleeved undyed wool shirt with the collar loose, wool trousers, soft hide boots, the red hair sticking up, the braids with wolf teeth hanging by the ears. He chews a strip of dried meat, a contented crooked grin.
battle: Ready to charge into the beasts: the bear-fur vest belted tight over the wool shirt, leather bracers on both forearms, leg wraps and boots. He holds one long fire-hardened spear with a ground bone tip in his right hand, drawn back to throw, the other six spears in a bundle on his back; a fierce, laughing look, the green eyes bright.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: leaning into a throw, the right arm drawn back with one long spear, the left hand out for balance, the feet planted wide, a fierce grin with the canine tooth showing.
formal: At the fire-handing at first snow: his cleanest undyed wool shirt laced shut at the throat with a rawhide thong under the bear-fur vest, a bone pin holding the vest edge, and on a cord at his chest the soot-blackened little clay fire-pot with white frost rimming its mouth and an ember pulsing inside. A fire-hardened spear with a ground bone tip stands upright beside him like a banner. He tries to stand solemn and cannot stop a small grin.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the spring-green eyes squinting with a wide bright grin showing the canine tooth. Warm orange campfire light on the front of his face, cool snow-blue light from behind. Foreground blur: a spear tip and drifting sparks. He wears the bear-fur vest open.

name: 米亚赫
src: 月银纪史诗/第一歌_灰桥初火.md:409
who: Miah, a human bone-setter's son of the far north, eighteen years old: slender and soft-featured, about 172 cm, thin-looking but strong enough to carry a grown man all day, clearly a grown young man and not a child. Soft cherry-pink curls piled over the forehead with one strand always sticking up. Pale sea-blue eyes with improbably long lashes that cast a small shadow on his cheek when he looks down at a wound. A delicate face with a pointed chin, very fair skin, long clean white hands whose knuckles never redden in the cold. He hates being called pretty. A gentle, careful, a little prickly air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a young man's delicate face, soft rounded eyes of pale sea blue with long dark-pink lashes, thin pink eyebrows, a small straight nose, a pointed chin, a gentle closed-mouth expression; clean skin with very little shading, shadows a soft pale pink.
palette: cherry pink, pale sea blue, walnut brown, bone white, clean linen
casual: His bone-setter's clothes: a felt robe dyed brown with walnut husk, knee-length, with a rabbit-fur collar and the sleeves rolled to the forearm, clean linen strips wound around both wrists; wool trousers and hide boots; at his belt two birch splint-boards that were his father's and a small jar of bear grease sealed with beeswax; a thin bone needle tucked into his left ear (on the viewer's right when they face us). He holds a roll of clean bandages, a careful, gentle look. The felt robe is cut like a northern coat: it closes straight down the centre front with a row of bone toggles from the fur collar to the belt, with fitted straight sleeves; no overlapping diagonal front, no sash.
private: Resting after the day's work: the felt robe off, a long-sleeved undyed wool shirt with the collar closed, wool trousers, soft hide boots, the pink curls sticking up. He washes his white hands with a handful of snow and then wraps them; a tired, small closed-mouth smile.
battle: Ready to carry the wounded: the walnut-brown felt robe belted tight, the sleeves tied back with linen strips, a satchel of bandages across the chest, the two splint-boards at his belt, hide boots. He holds one splint-board in his right hand like a short club and a roll of bandage in his left; a worried but steady look, the mouth shut. The robe closes straight down the centre front with bone toggles under the belt and has fitted straight sleeves; no overlapping diagonal front.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: not a fighter, planted and steady with the shoulders squared, holding a splint-board close in the right hand and a roll of bandage in the left, a worried but determined look, the mouth closed.
formal: At the fire-handing at first snow: a clean walnut-brown felt robe brushed, a fresh rabbit-fur collar, the linen strips on both wrists freshly bleached, and the bear-grease jar held in both hands. The robe closes straight down the front with bone toggles under a hide-thong belt and has fitted narrow sleeves; on a cord at his neck hangs the soot-blackened clay fire-pot, frost white on its rim, a small ember glowing within. He stands very upright; a shy, serious look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly and lowered a little, the pale sea-blue eyes looking up at the viewer under the long lashes, serious and gentle, the mouth closed. Soft warm fire light from one side, cool snow-blue light from the other. Foreground blur: drifting snow and a blurred white bandage held up near the lens. He wears the brown felt robe with the rabbit-fur collar.

name: 海拉斯
src: 月银纪史诗/第一歌_灰桥初火.md:466
who: Hellas, a human rope-twister from the far south, twenty-two years old, a refugee in the north: about 176 cm, wiry and long-limbed, climbs bridge piers and squeezes through ice cracks, ten fingers as nimble as if grown from rope. Honey-brown skin from the southern sun, the only warm-coloured face among the pale northerners. Black curly hair braided into many strands with fine hemp cord twisted into them, a single lock hanging over the forehead. Honey-amber eyes whose corners slant up when he smiles. A small bone ring in the left ear (on the viewer's right when they face us). Both forearms are tattooed with rows of rope-knot patterns, one knot for each thing he remembers. Easygoing, shivering, always smiling as if it were summer.
face: FACE, as in the references: a young man's warm face of about twenty-two, gently slanted honey-amber eyes whose outer corners lift when he smiles, a thin tapering dark-brown upper lash line, straight black eyebrows, a small straight nose, an easy open smile with ordinary teeth; honey-brown skin with soft warm-brown shadows.
build: 176 cm, wiry and long-limbed: narrow shoulders, long arms and legs, lean and flexible, sinewy hands.
palette: honey brown, black hair with red thread, amber, hemp straw, borrowed hide brown
casual: His refugee clothes: a thin southern hemp short-sleeved tunic with three layers of borrowed hides wrapped over it, still shivering, the hands tucked into the fur at his chest; the rope-knot tattoos showing on the bare forearms; hemp trousers wrapped with leg bindings, hide-wrapped feet; a big coil of evenly twisted hemp rope, as big as a cooking pot, slung over one shoulder; a small bone knife with a red cord wound round the handle at his belt. A warm grin.
private: Huddled in the warmth: the hides off except one thick fur wrapped round the shoulders, a long-sleeved hemp tunic under it, hemp trousers, hide-wrapped feet, the braids hanging loose; both hands wrapped round a hot clay cup. A relieved easy smile.
battle: Ready to fight with a rope: the three borrowed hides cinched with a rope belt, hemp leg bindings, hide-wrapped feet. He holds a long loop of rope in his right hand, whirled ready to throw, and the red-corded bone knife in his left; the big coil hangs across his chest; a sharp, quick look, the mouth set.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: light on his feet, one hand whirling a long rope loop overhead, the other holding the small bone knife low at his side, a sharp, quick look, the mouth closed.
formal: At the fire-handing at first snow: a clean hemp tunic with the rope-knot tattoos on the forearms deliberately bared, one good borrowed fur laid neatly over the shoulders and held with a bone pin, a plaited rope sash at the waist. On a cord at his chest hangs the soot-blackened clay fire-pot, frost on its mouth and an ember glowing inside, and he offers a neatly coiled rope in both hands. He stands up straight, a warm shy smile.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the honey-amber eyes looking straight at the viewer, bright and easy, a warm closed-mouth smile. Warm orange fire light on his face, cool snow-blue light behind him. Foreground blur: a loose loop of rope near the lens and drifting snow. The hide wraps are pulled up round his neck.

name: 妮欧贝
src: 月银纪史诗/第一歌_灰桥初火.md:523
who: Niobe, a human woman of the far north, twenty-three years old, a searcher of the lost: about 168 cm, very thin after this winter. Long glossy black hair to the waist, neither braided nor tied, streaming behind her in the wind like a black banner. A pale, bloodless face with exquisitely made features, grey-blue eyes whose rims have been red for a long time from weeping, lips kept pressed together, a very soft voice. She wears no cloak even in the snow. Always carries a small rabbit-skin baby's shoe against her chest. A still, grave, grieving air that makes people afraid to speak to her.
face: FACE, as in the references: a woman's delicate face of about twenty-three, long gently slanted grey-blue eyes with reddened rims and a long thin dark upper lash line, thin straight black eyebrows, a small straight nose, a closed mouth with lips pressed together; very pale skin, shadows a cool pale pink.
build: 168 cm, thin and slender: narrow shoulders, a delicate frame, a C-cup, a small waist and softly narrow hips, thin wrists that a hand can close around.
palette: raven black, grey-blue, ash grey wool, pale skin, faded rabbit-skin cream
casual: Her searching clothes: a long grey felt-wool robe with a long skirt to the ankles and long sleeves, closed at the neck, an old scrap of baby swaddling cloth stitched inside the hem; no cloak or wrap on the shoulders; hide-wrapped boots; held against her chest in both hands a tiny rabbit-skin shoe with a crooked little fox stitched on the toe. The long black hair loose. A still, grieving look.
private: At night, off duty: the same grey robe with a thick undyed wool shawl a child gave her over the shoulders, soft hide shoes, the black hair loose over one shoulder; she holds the tiny shoe in her lap and does not look at the viewer. A quiet, hollow look.
battle: Setting out across the snow to follow a track: the grey felt robe belted tight with a leather strap, the sleeves tied back, leather mittens, hide boots laced high, a walking staff of plain wood in her right hand, the tiny shoe pinned inside her robe at the chest; the black hair braided back for once; a fixed, unflinching look, the mouth shut.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: not a fighter, standing braced and steady in a ready walking stance, a plain wooden staff held in her right hand and her left hand pressed flat over her chest, a fixed, unflinching look, the mouth closed.
formal: At the fire-handing at first snow: the grey wool robe brushed clean, a plain black wool mantle over the shoulders pinned with a bone pin, the long black hair combed and falling straight, the tiny shoe held out on her open palms. She stands very straight; a grave, restrained look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the red-rimmed grey-blue eyes looking straight at the viewer, grave and open, the mouth closed. Cold blue snow light from one side, a thin warm line of firelight along her cheek. The black hair blown across the frame. Foreground blur: drifting snow and a small blurred shoe held at the edge of the frame.
